title: Automation
description: Assignment rules, tasks created when deals change stage, alerts and SLA escalation. Every automated change is recorded in the audit log as "Automation".

common.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

assignment.title: Assignment rules
assignment.description: Rules run top to bottom for every inbound lead (and for CRM leads when "Assign using rules" is ticked). The first matching rule decides the owner.
assignment.emptyDescription: Without rules, leads follow the fallback below.
assignment.targetPool: Round-robin across {count, plural, one {# user} other {# users}}

fields.name: Rule name
fields.countriesHint: Leave empty to match any country.
fields.companiesHint: Leave empty to match any company.
fields.sourcesHint: Leave empty to match any source.
fields.poolHint: Leads rotate through these users in order. Inactive or read-only users are skipped.
fields.stopHint: Do not try later rules when this one matches.

preview.title: Test this rule set
preview.description: See who the next lead with these details would go to, using all saved rules.
preview.resultRule: This lead would go to {name} via rule "{rule}".

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: Used when no rule matches. Managed in Setup.

assignment.invalidTarget: Choose a user, or at least one pool member.

editorPreview.title: Estimate for this rule
editorPreview.description: Pick a sample lead to see who would receive it with this rule and the saved ones. Round-robin position is not considered, so this is an estimate.
editorPreview.resultRound: Estimated owner: {name} (next in rotation may differ)
editorPreview.none: No rule would assign this lead; the fallback applies.

stageTasks.title: Stage tasks
stageTasks.description: When an opportunity enters a stage, these tasks are created automatically.
stageTasks.dueIn: Due in {days, plural, =0 {0 days (same day)} one {# day} other {# days}}

alerts.title: Alerts & SLA
alerts.description: Alerts appear in the bell. The first-response SLA creates an urgent task for the owner's manager.

stalled.title: Stalled deals
stalled.description: Notify the owner when an open opportunity has had no stage change or activity for this long.
stalled.label: Days without progress

overdue.title: Overdue tasks
overdue.description: Notify the assignee when an open task is past due.
overdue.label: Grace period (hours)

sla.title: Lead SLA escalation
sla.description: When a new lead gets no first response within the SLA, the owner keeps it and their manager gets a notification and an urgent task.

slaHours.title: First-response SLA
slaHours.warning: Warning after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
slaHours.overdue: Escalates after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
slaHours.explanation: Escalation uses the overdue threshold of the lead first-response SLA ({hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}). These hours are read-only here; they also drive the badges on the lead list.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: A more specific rule wins: stage, then pipeline, then the global setting.

alerts.saveFailed: Could not save the alert settings.
alerts.missingGlobal: No global rule exists for this alert yet. Saving creates it.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: The engine runs every 15 minutes (a daily run is the fallback). Stalled deals, overdue tasks and SLA escalations are checked on each run.
runs.emptyDescription: The first scheduled run will appear here.

sla.taskBody: The owner has not responded within the SLA. Follow up with them or contact the lead.
